outputs.explanation: Panel A shows only fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge) with no plotted averages; the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B includes micrographs and two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) showing only mean ± error bar with no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image with no averaged/plotted data, so the check does not apply.
Panel D contains histochemical micrographs plus bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity (with N per group indicated) showing only mean ± error bar without individual data points overlaid.

Panel E shows FACS histogram distributions (cell counts vs TMRM intensity) for individual replicate experiments; these are distribution/line-type plots that already display the full data spread, so overlaid individual points are not required.
